div.div:
Legend
━━ request path ╍╍ auth, control and delivery ┈┈ planned (code still a stub) ╍╍ alerts
No VPC, NAT or servers: Lambda, S3, SQS and Scheduler are pay per use. Owner-only stacks deploy from the owner laptop with CLI credentials; CI deploys CronistaAccountGuards, CronistaWebAcl, CronistaDomain, CronistaEdge and CronistaWorkers.
